page.overview:
Who is Able Doone?

After being escorted off the property, Doone returned to his home and vowed to get revenge against those who rejected him by making them die laughing. That night he broke into Grumlin's house and proceeded to tickle the man to death. The Angel arrived on the property but was too late to stop him from murdering Grumlin and was almost killed himself if not for the timely arrival of Grumlin's bodyguard. Able Doone fled into the night.

Later, on the set of the film which the Angel was hired upon, Doone struck again. He attempted to kill the star of the picture. The Angel intervened once more and this time managed to fight off his attacker. Doone was turned over to the authorities.
